rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Parked-up Stanley Terrace kerb, but homes sit 10-20 m behind it.

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb on this side: one 9 m back at 10 m along, one 10 m back at 49 m along. The 20-40 m gap is the furthest from both, still within about 15 m of each.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking lane with cars parked, room to pull fully off the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way street, cars parked on both sides.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, so a van fits in. 2P limit applies, with resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm.

flags: Dwellings close: 9-10 m at both ends of the section
2P parking signs, resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm
sun_shade: Dense canopy over the north side shades the section; the road is open to the south.

best_section.where: North kerb of Stanley Terrace, between the two houses, under heavy tree cover
